title: Glassy Hakka Salt and Pepper Squid
description: Fermented and crispy squid dish with a glassy jelly texture, inspired by traditional Hakka Chinese cuisine. This recipe is vegan-friendly and perfect for Buddhist temple gatherings.
instructions: Rinse the squid rings under cold water and pat them dry with paper towels.
In a bowl, mix together the potato starch, cornstarch, and a pinch of salt.
Add the squid rings to the bowl and coat them evenly with the starch mixture.
Heat the vegetable oil in a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the fermented soybean paste and garlic to the wok and stir-fry until fragrant.
Add the squid rings to the wok and stir-fry until they are crispy and golden brown.
Remove the squid from the wok and set them aside on a plate.
In the same wok, add the black pepper and salt, and stir-fry for 1 minute.
Add the squid back to the wok and toss them with the black pepper and salt mixture.
Serve the Glassy Hakka Salt and Pepper Squid hot, garnished with chopped scallions if desired.
